bio.text: Gregg Mele is the Republican candidate for New Jersey's 12th Congressional District.

According to WHYY, he is an attorney who lives in Plainfield, graduated from Montclair State University, received a law degree from New York University School of Law, and has worked as a graduate professor at Stevens Institute of Technology.
He ran for Congress in the 7th District as an independent in 2018, was the Libertarian nominee for governor in 2021, and lost the 2024 Republican primary in the 6th District.
